prompt: On a quiz, each question is worth $4$ points, so your score is $f(q) = 4q$. What is $f(3)$? Give just the number.
hint: The notation $f(3)$ is not multiplication. It tells you which input to feed into the rule.

hints.text: The notation $f(3)$ is not multiplication. It tells you which input to feed into the rule.
Replace $q$ with $3$ in the rule $f(q) = 4q$, which gives the product $4 \times 3$ to work out.
Multiplying gives $4 \times 3 = 12$, so $f(3)$ is a score of $12$ points.

explanation: The rule $f(q) = 4q$ takes a number of questions as its input and gives points as its output.
$f(3)$ means the input is $3$, so replace $q$ with $3$ and multiply: $4 \times 3 = 12$.
So $f(3) = 12$, meaning three correct questions earn $12$ points.
